notes.muse_not_on_path: Resolved 2026-11-03 about 03:35 UTC: Dispatch appended %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\muse to the user PATH (append only). In a fresh shell `muse` resolves to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\muse\muse.cmd and the live-install case runs and passes (11 tests, no skip).
notes.red2_required_cases: from the facilitator's read of green 1, named in refactor 41ecf78: (a) _detect_sign_in tests 'signed in' before 'not signed in', so a not-signed-in reply reads as signed-in; (b) a version mismatch is appended to problems twice. Criterion 1's cap (1 cycle) is spent, so both go to red 2 (criterion 2 owns the not-signed-in state).
notes.red3_required_cases: green 2's muse backend invocation is 'muse -p {PROMPT} --model {MODEL}', but Muse has no -p flag (`muse --help`): its headless mode is `muse exec`, which has --prompt-file <PATH> (avoids the .CMD shim's 8191-character command-line limit, the cause of the empty Grok and Copilot votes), --session-id <UUID> (pins the session log the reader locates) and --json. The backend is disabled, so nothing misfires now; red 3 must pin a working invocation with {SESSION}.
notes.commit_author: from green 1 (2196c58) on, every Copilot seat commit is authored by the Copilot CLI's own identity ('Copilot', see git log %an); red 1 (5ef4b8f) and red 1b (970118c) carry the shared identity Xipooo. Relevant to card 275 (seat attribution)
notes.gate_gaps: for the gate and the sign-in follow-up: (1) the muse invocation uses --json, so the reply is JSONL events while decider.parse_vote reads a plain first line, so a Muse vote would be voteless until the output is cleaned or --json dropped; (2) --model {MODEL} with models default='default' is unverified against `muse exec`; (3) locate_muse uses only Path.home(), not the slice's XDG_DATA_HOME, then HOME, then USERPROFILE rule; (4) red 3b dropped the disabled and unknown-pin tests. None can be proven before sign-in except (3) and (4).
notes.past_cap_items: after sign-in, items past the D175 caps (each criterion spent its 1 cycle), for a scope window before any red: (1) muse_install._detect_sign_in reports 'unknown' for the signed-in usage text (Tier/Window/Weekly), and Dispatch notes a fresh subscription prints 'No usage data (server_sent_no_usage)', which must read as signed in with unknown quota, never not-signed-in; (2) --json reply versus decider.parse_vote; (3) enabling the muse backend and the card's metric, one Muse voting seat probed, scanned and casting a cited vote in a decision window; (4) locate_muse ignores XDG_DATA_HOME and USERPROFILE; (5) red 3b dropped the disabled and unknown-pin tests; (6) 'Agent delegation: auto unavailable: workspace is untrusted' outside a repo (Dispatch)
